# AgentPress Material Kit: Auth0: interstitial captcha

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://auth0.com/docs/libraries/acul/react-sdk/API-Reference/Screens/interstitial-captcha
Ecosystem: Auth0
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for OAuth/OIDC/auth management docs: interstitial captcha

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
